comments.text: What struck me most isn't just the turquoise lagoons, but how tight-knit the community remains despite everything history threw at them. When your entire land is only a few meters wide, sharing and caring for your neighbors isn't optional—it's the only way to survive. Beautiful look into a culture that deserves way more global support.l
